traits.name: Abduct
traits.text: The bugbear needn’t spend extra movement to move a creature it is grappling.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The bugbear makes two Javelin or Morn- ingstar attacks.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.text: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 10 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Morningstar
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5 (with Advantage if the target is Grappled by the bugbear), reach 10 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage. Bonus Actions

actions.name: Quick Grapple
actions.text: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 13, one Medium or smaller creature the bugbear can see within 10 feet. Failure: The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13).

legendaryActions.name: Legendary Action Uses
legendaryActions.text: 3 (4 in Lair). Immediately after another creature’s turn, the dragon can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The dragon regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

legendaryActions.name: Guiding Light
legendaryActions.text: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast Guiding Bolt (level 2 version).

legendaryActions.name: Pounce
legendaryActions.text: The dragon moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Rend attack.

legendaryActions.name: Thunderclap
legendaryActions.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 22, each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the dragon can see within 120 feet. Failure: 13 (3d8) Thunder damage, and the target has the Deafened con- dition until the end of its next turn. Bugbears Bugbear Stalker
